CosmeticDescriptions.You are hurt, bloodied, but stronger tha: You are hurt, bloodied, but stronger than ever.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You've climbed enough to show signs of y: You've climbed enough to show signs of your experience.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Happy Holidays! These should keep you pl: Happy Holidays! These should keep you plenty warm.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Leather gloves: Terrible for climbing, b: Leather gloves: Terrible for climbing, but nothing is cooler.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You only see the concrete you are grabbi: You only see the concrete you are grabbing, the rebar you are throwing. Your form does not matter.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You have survived many horrors. Maybe es: You have survived many horrors. Maybe escape really is possible.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.<i>It was beautiful, a <color=red>brilli: It was beautiful, a brilliant gleaming thing. How the Authority would pay for their crimes, in such exquisite agony.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.<i>I felt pain there, as the <color=red>: I felt pain there, as the sphere radiated. I would change from that rotten form into something new, something pure.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You've been through so much, but the wor: You've been through so much, but the world has changed you.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.This particular tattoo is common among t: This particular tattoo is common among the SB10 extermination teams.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Tape is commonly used to protect your ha: Tape is commonly used to protect your hands during climbs.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You are something else, something from b: You are something else, something from beyond the veil. Maybe you were human once. Maybe.[CS]
Your body is falling apart at the seams. Lets hope you make it out before it collapses.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.The worshippers of Rho were given many g: The worshippers of Rho were given many gifts by the enigmatic force beyond their rift. They all came at a cost. You, however, were never alive to begin with.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Child of the Burrowfolk, you've only eve: Child of the Burrowfolk, you've only ever known the Facility. Its more of a home to you than the grottos those old stories describe.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You delved deep into a pseudo-periphery,: You delved deep into a pseudo-periphery, and came out changed. A copy of a copy.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Even with the strength of stone, you ble: Even with the strength of stone, you bleed.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You messed with the demon sphere, huh?: You messed with the demon sphere, huh?[CS]
This hammer has a wooden shaft.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Scientifically proven to be the best too: Scientifically proven to be the best tool of choice.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Torn off a wall somewhere, this should w: Torn off a wall somewhere, this should work just fine.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.You're not sure how a woodworking tool e: You're not sure how a woodworking tool ended up at the bottom of SB12, but it works well enough for you to not care.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Discovered in the deep facility after th: Discovered in the deep facility after the First Event, now auctioned off.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.Some species of the Lambda Roach were th: Some species of the Lambda Roach were the size of bears. If you're lucky you'll never see one.[CS]
CosmeticDescriptions.A trusty wrench, capable of bashing just: A trusty wrench, capable of bashing just as well as anything else.[CS]
